basis: Three attributable project reactions from opened pages: official support, a resident’s pre-opening noise/process concerns, and an arrival passenger’s experience. Dates are original publication days, not later updates. Sentiment is an editorial estimate of each excerpt’s tone toward this airport, not a measured satisfaction survey. Stored as critic reactions, never reader comments.

reviews.title: Chris Bowen — official opening announcement — Western Sydney International Airport to open to passengers in October
reviews.quote: Western Sydney’s gateway to the world is opening soon, and it will open ready to support Sustainable Aviation Fuel.

reviews.title: Resident Ms Wong — community concerns reported by ABC — New Western Sydney International Airport opens after 80 years of debate and protests
reviews.quote: It's such a kick in the guts that they are opening it without addressing any of the community's concerns.

reviews.title: Passenger Julie Lundmark — arrival confusion reported by ABC — Opening of new Western Sydney airport causes confusion for some travellers
reviews.quote: We landed here and looked out of the window and had no idea where we were,
